---
name: Proposal
about: Propose a bounded rendering, metadata, or scientific-communication improvement
title: "[Proposal] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Problem or user outcome
Describe the concrete communication or rendering need without implying unsupported scientific authority.

## Proposed contract
Define inputs, outputs, metadata, failure behavior, compatibility, and the smallest intended scope.

## Current evidence and alternatives
Separate current implementation facts, active contract semantics, external standards, and preferences.

## Affected surfaces
List implementation, `MANIFEST.yaml`, recipe/schema contracts, current documents, metadata, or maintenance surfaces that require synchronization.

## Acceptance criteria
State observable review criteria relevant to the proposal.

## Non-goals and semantic risks
State what the proposal must not imply about figure correctness, evidence sufficiency, confidence, or scientific validation.
